hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the acting enemy.
Let resultObjectsInFrame be the results "damaged_creator" this frame.
If resultObjectsInFrame is not empty, then
  If the current form of the enemy is "1", then
    The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM immediately with options {messageSuffixNo: "01"} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
    The enemy → register-interrupt-ability-by-tag with ("reflection", {skipStepCnt: true, skipAttackMotion: true}, {interruptBeforeCounter: true}).
    The enemy changes to form "2".
    The enemy cancels its cast.
  Otherwise, if the current form of the enemy is "2", then
    The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM immediately with options {messageSuffixNo: "02"} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
    The enemy changes to form "3".
    The enemy → unset-status-ailments with (call game:StatusAilmentsConfig.getBundle with (game:Conf.STATUS_AILMENTS_BUNDLE.REFLECTIONS)).
    The enemy cancels its cast.
  Otherwise, if the current form of the enemy is "3", then _ → any with (resultObjectsInFrame, given (x) { If x meets the damage condition {detectedElementId: [game:Conf.ELEMENT_TYPE.NONE, game:Conf.ELEMENT_TYPE.NOTHING]}, then { The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM immediately with options {messageSuffixNo: "03"} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}. The enemy changes to form "4". The enemy cancels its cast. Return true. } }, this state).
  Otherwise, if the register's 'counterCount' is at least the numeric entry "counter_limit_in_reaction_phase" in aiArg, then
    The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM immediately with options {messageSuffixNo: "05"} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
    The enemy changes to form "1".
    The enemy cancels its cast.
    Set the register's 'counterCount' to 0.
  Otherwise, _ → any with (resultObjectsInFrame, given (x) { Return not not call game:util.DamageCalculator.isEnableCounter with (x) and (if x meets the move condition {isPhysicalAttack: true} and util passes a fraction roll of the numeric entry "counter_rate_by_physical_attack" in aiArg then (the enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM immediately with options {messageSuffixNo: "04"} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}, then the enemy → register-interrupt-ability-by-tag with ("curse_eyes", {skipStepCnt: true, isCounter: true}, {interruptBeforeCounter: true}), then the register's 'counterCount' before increasing, then true) else if x meets the move condition {isBlackMagicAttack: true} and util passes a fraction roll of the numeric entry "counter_rate_by_black_magic" in aiArg then (the enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM immediately with options {messageSuffixNo: "04"} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}, then the enemy → register-interrupt-ability-by-tag with ("flare", {skipStepCnt: true, isCounter: true}, {interruptBeforeCounter: true}), then the register's 'counterCount' before increasing, then true) else if x meets the move condition {isWhiteMagicAttack: true} and util passes a fraction roll of the numeric entry "counter_rate_by_white_magic" in aiArg then (the enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM immediately with options {messageSuffixNo: "04"} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}, then the enemy → register-interrupt-ability-by-tag with ("holy", {skipStepCnt: true, isCounter: true}, {interruptBeforeCounter: true}), then the register's 'counterCount' before increasing, then true) else nothing). }, this state).
If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
